verdict.rationale: The pack includes a first-party Monitors doc page, which is Datadog's own rule-based alerting feature, but the evidence is only the page title. Nothing in the pack describes rule definition, event triggers, or the automated actions those rules fire. missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition, documented automatic actions beyond the title (e.g., workflow automation or remediation), explicit event-trigger semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
